services.title: Landscaping

reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Begum Ayder
reviews.text: I recently hired this landscaping company and had an excellent experience from start to finish. The team was professional, reliable, and highly organized, making the entire process smooth and stress free. From the initial consultation, they took the time to understand my vision, discuss options, and provide helpful recommendations for improving my outdoor space. The quality of the landscaping work was outstanding. The crew demonstrated great attention to detail while handling everything from lawn care and planting to trimming, mulching, and overall landscape design. I especially appreciated the care they took to ensure that every aspect of the project looked neat, healthy, and visually appealing.

reviews.author: Emily J
reviews.text: Hunter and his team did an absolutely amazing job on trimming and cutting down years of overgrown bushes. He gave us an estimate quickly and scheduled a day to start the job. The day of the job, they worked so hard to make our front yard look fantastic. They worked fast and efficiently, they completed the job in 1 day. Our front yard looks better than we were expecting. When they were done, they cleaned up and checked with us to make sure we were satisfied with the job. I couldn't have asked for anything better. Highly recommend Hunter and his team to complete any landscaping job. Kind and respectful of neighbors. You won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Karen Pendergrass
reviews.text: Hunter and team took excellent care of our yard in Virginia Beach. Even on days when rain had left the yard mushy, they were there as scheduled. Very dependable and respectful. When a rock flew and shattered my storm door window, while they were using a weeder, Hunter took care of the cost of replacement. Job well done & with integrity. Thanks guys! Mrs. Pendergrass

reviews.author: Kristopher Ruiz
reviews.text: Hunter did an amazing job with leaf and debris removal after my tenants trashed my backyard. He was awesome to work with and was able to provide next day service. I would highly recommend him

reviews.author: Kerri Sabo
reviews.text: Hunters lawn and landscape did a great job on my property. The crew was punctual and handled everything on my list. Earlier in the season, they planted bulbs for me (I had surgery and could not do it), and my garden looks amazing!

reviews.author: Gary N
reviews.text: Hunter was recommended to me at a time I was seeking a reliable company to take care of my large yard. He started in the spring of 2022 and he will be with me as long as he wants. He is punctual, hardworking, responsive, and customer oriented. Before he started, we walked the property and he asked me if I had any specific issues I wanted addressed. He said that my satisfaction is the most important part of his work. That is very refreshing in this business. He asked me to come out to the yard the first couple of times he mowed and edged to be sure it was done to my liking. He has great pride in making the yard look its very best. I hired him also for spring cleanup which entailed a lot of shrub cutting, hauling away cuttings, some transplanting of flowers, and bringing in and spreading 5 yards of mulch. Hunter is a very oriented to working hard until the job is finished. I have recommended him to many friends, and those who have contracted with him are very satisfied. If you are reading this to the end, I encourage you to give Hunter a call and let him provide a quote. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Inquiries Country Villa
reviews.text: Hunter and his team have been absolutely stellar at making my business property and my home property look great for over a year now. From mulch to mowing, seeding, taking out crazy overgrown plants, to just blowing off leaves and gumballs, every wedding looks perfect thanks to them. Can’t thank you guys enough! They are early every time, they are thorough, and most importantly, they communicate :) see you next Thursday, fellas!

reviews.author: Tyler Charles
reviews.text: Not lawn care related, but Hunter Landscaping saved a stranded driver who got their vehicle stuck in a snow drift. And after he pulled the car from the ditch he used his own equipment and plowed the trouble spot in the road to prevent anyone else from sliding into the ditch. I didn’t catch the Good Samaritan’s name but he was driving a Hunters lawn and Landscaping truck. Good work! Good to see there are good people out there.

reviews.author: Anthony Paul Trace
reviews.text: Hunter did an AMAZING job with our mulch! Very professional, responsive and high quality mulch. Great guy and very respectful. We've had lots of people stop buy and tell us how great the yard looks - and we were happy to share his info.

reviews.author: Maidya J- Flowers
reviews.text: Job sent my husband and I in two different travel directions and previous lawn arrangements fell through. Found Hunter on Google and he came in, assessed the yard situation (which was borderline out of control) and completely overhauled our yard and even outlined a whole plan to get our yard cleaned up and winter ready. I am beyond greatful Hunter's time, attention to detail, and great care of my yard!

reviews.author: Michelle Derr
reviews.text: Hunter was great! He was responsive, polite and did an outstanding job. He removed and hauled away old landscaping timbers surrounding multiple flower beds, replaced with border bricks and mulched. Our yard looks so much better now. I will definitely be using him for any future projects and recommend him wholeheartedly!

reviews.author: Douglas Edmonds
reviews.text: Hunter's Lawn & Landscape was recommended to me by a neighbor and i have been using Hunter's service for a couple of years now. I am extremely satisfied with the quality of his work. He's honest, dependable and professional and takes pride in his trade. I highly recommend his service.

reviews.author: troy olivo
reviews.text: Absolutely loving the work from Hunter's Lawn and Landscape! He definitely has an eye for detail and my yard has never looked better. Had him come out and do a clean up and lay some mulch he completely turned my yard around and it looks amazing. I Highly recommend hunter for anyone looking to spruce up their outdoor space!

reviews.author: Austin Ange
reviews.text: Hunter is very good young man and his work speaks for itself. He’s done work for me and my neighbors and it’s always been great quality. I highly recommend him if you’re looking for an honest, hardworking young man who does quality work!

reviews.author: Travis Knaub
reviews.text: Hunter did an amazing job at our property! He mowed the grass, did a spring clean up, and put down 5 yards of mulch. The finished product looks very clean and professional. I highly recommend Hunters Lawn and Landscape for your yards needs. Very reliable and punctual young man.

reviews.author: Stephanie Marangoni
reviews.text: Hunter is punctual,hard working and on the ball. He did a fabulous job edging, tidying up the yard. Did not leave until the job was done. So pleasant and respectful. Asked appropriate questions and prices are good. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Robert Grimm
reviews.text: Called Hunter for a landscaping estimate on a corner lot that needed some TLC and also some tree work. He provided a fair price and had all the equipment to get the job done correctly with professionalism and the attention to detail I expected. He will now be my landscaper moving forward and I would highly recommend his services.

reviews.author: Gianella Angulo
reviews.text: Hunter was a pleasant surprise! I was driving, saw one of his signs and called him. I was immediately answered by a friendly voice and he came down the next morning to help us clear it out. This is our first time owning a house, so it’s nice to know we will always have hunter for future projects. Thank you Hunter for being on time, reliable, friendly and helpful! May Jesus continue to bless your business!

reviews.author: Cheryl Shoen
reviews.text: Hunter and his team did a great job updating my landscaping, removing unwanted plants and replacing them with new. Also mulched all of our beds. A very professional job at a reasonable price and done with care. Highly recommend Hunter for your lawn or landscaping needs.

reviews.author: Marcus D
reviews.text: Hunter and his crew did an outstanding job on my front lawn that needed a lot of help. Excellent service that was done in a timely manner & very helpful. Definitely will hire again when needed!

reviews.author: Rodnie Allanigue
reviews.text: Hunter is very observant went it comes to taking care of the simplest detail in our yard, from the edging to the grass height. I always enjoy the end result after a lawn mow. He’s open to listening to your concerns and requests on what needs to be done and very flexible with schedule changes. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Amy Burgess
reviews.text: Can’t recommend Hunter’s Lawn and Landscape enough! They were quick to quote, professional, and did a great job. Our yard was transformed in a day after much needed trimming, weeding and mulching. Thank you Hunter.

reviews.author: Barbara Green
reviews.text: Hunter and his crew did a beautiful job laying mulch in my flower beds. They were punctual, hard working and polite young men. I recommend this company for anyone needing landscaping and yard work.

reviews.author: Melissa Stottlemyer
reviews.text: This company is top notch! Hunter (the owner) is very professional and detail oriented. He is very focused and does a great job! He is very reasonably priced especially considering the amazing job he does! I highly recommend this company for your landscaping needs!

reviews.author: los brazy
reviews.text: Hunter is the real deal! He does some seriously great work, always bringing his A-game. Not only that, but he's super nice and a total hard worker. Highly recommend his services, no doubt!

reviews.author: Randall Kopytowski
reviews.text: Hunter and crew did a great job on my yard. They did a full spring clean up and removed all the pine needles and pine cones from my yard and driveway. Definitely worth the price and I will be using them again.

reviews.author: Andrew E
reviews.text: Hunter and his crew are the best! They do a professional and efficient job at weekly maintenance at my workplace!

reviews.author: A ZimmerLife
reviews.text: Hunter was very communicative and easy to work with. Highly recommend Hunter's Lawn & Landscape for anything you need done!

reviews.author: Patrice Lavoie
reviews.text: Hunter’s Landscaping is an awesome find for landscape management. Hunter’s quality of work is impressive; thorough; consistent. Hunter always leaves a beautifully manicured lawn.

reviews.author: Lawrence Niederkorn
reviews.text: Hunter just laid down 14 yards of mulch at my place, and man, it looks amazing! Super neat and professionally done. Top-notch service all the way!

reviews.author: Alis Smith
reviews.text: They did a spectacular job on my mom's yard! It was a bit out of their way but they did it for us anyway. It was over run with gumballs and they raked and edged to perfection, looks like a whole new yard. Thank you guys for all your help we greatly appreciate it.

reviews.author: christine arzadon
reviews.text: Hunter was highly recommended to me. He is professional and very responsive to every message. I plan to use him for regular yard upkeep.

reviews.author: Gracie C
reviews.text: Hunter was very prompt, courteous, and did a great job. I would highly recommend using his service. Great job!!!

reviews.author: Ann Sagle
reviews.text: What a lovely young man! We had Hunter complete our spring mulching and we could not be more pleased. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Erika Kachur
reviews.text: Hunter and his team did a great job with yard clean up and mowing. Will definitely continue with his services as needed.

reviews.author: Stephanie Jones
reviews.text: I hired Hunter to clean my back yard from leaves from last season. My yard has never looked better! We're going to be regular mowing customers now!

reviews.author: Joncarlos S
reviews.text: Hunter’s Lawn and Landscape came out on short notice and did an amazing job on my elderly mother’s property. I couldn’t be happier with their services.

reviews.author: david rivas
reviews.text: The young man is very reliable and very knowledgeable in what needs to be done. I have used him for 2 years and I couldn’t ask for a better person to keep my lawn in order.

reviews.author: Impact Landscaping
reviews.text: Great attention to detail and very easy to work with. I recommend Hunter for lawncare if you live in the kempsville or green run area

reviews.author: Katie Stottlemyer
reviews.text: Hunter did an awesome job with our fall clean up. Will definitely be using his service in the future.

reviews.author: michelle kelly
reviews.text: Hunter and crew did an amazing job, timely, professional and hard workers. I give them a 10 out of 10.

reviews.author: Brent Hartigan
reviews.text: The work is second to none. Hunter is communicative, fast, and his work is perfect. Use his services every chance you can.

reviews.author: Amir Arsalan
reviews.text: 5 star service. They were professional, punctual, and courteous. I would highly recommend this company and plan to use them again in the future.
